description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeysCapabilities class, specifically testing support for different key systems, their versions, and support status, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCapabilitiesKeySystemsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for MediaKeysCapabilities key systems support tests, setting up mocks and shared resources.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Tests that getSupportedKeySystems returns the correct list of supported key systems based on mock responses.

methods.name: DoesSupportKeySystem
methods.description: Tests that supportsKeySystem returns true when the key system is supported.

methods.name: DoesNotSupportKeySystem
methods.description: Tests that supportsKeySystem returns false when the key system is not supported.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionSuccess
methods.description: Tests that getSupportedKeySystemVersion successfully retrieves the version when creation and getVersion calls succeed.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionOcdmSystemFailure
methods.description: Tests that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns false when creating the ocdm system fails.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionGetVersionFailure
methods.description: Tests that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns false when getVersion call fails.
